definitionZh: :-moz-locale-dir(ltr) CSS伪类是一个Mozilla扩展,如果用户界面显示为左对右,则它匹配一个元素. 这是由偏好intl.uidiction决定的。 locale(其中locale为当前locale)被设置为"ltr".
sourceDefinition: The :-moz-locale-dir(ltr) CSS pseudo-class is a Mozilla extension that matches an element if the user interface is being displayed left-to-right. This is determined by the preference intl.uidirection.locale (where locale is the current locale) being set to "ltr".
